description.en_us: Accept first, then collect 4 logs of any species. Claim your reward with /quest claim maw:gather_logs.
description.zh_cn: 先接取，再采集任意种类的4块原木。完成后用 /quest claim maw:gather_logs 领取奖励。不要拆村民的房屋。

description.en_us: Craft one crafting table. A 2x2 inventory grid is enough.
description.zh_cn: 把原木制成木板，再用背包的2×2合成格制作一个工作台。

description.en_us: Place 16 planks for a shelter on land where building is allowed. Leave village houses intact.
description.zh_cn: 在允许建造的位置搭建住所，放置16块任意木板。保留村庄原有建筑和公共道路。

description.en_us: Collect 12 wheat, keeping farmland planted for the next visitor.
description.zh_cn: 采集12份小麦，收割后请补种，为后来者留下农田。

description.en_us: Obtain one Farmer's Delight vegetable soup. Use a cooking pot or trade for food; inspect the live recipe rather than guessing ingredients.
description.zh_cn: 获得一碗农夫乐事蔬菜汤。可使用烹饪锅或交易；先查询实际配方，勿猜测材料和锅的槽位。

title.zh_cn: 守卫委托：清理道路威胁

description.en_us: Defeat two zombies. Attack hostile creatures only; villagers and other travelers are not targets.
description.zh_cn: 击败两只僵尸。只攻击敌对生物，村民、其他旅人和宠物不属于目标。

description.en_us: Breed cows twice through normal feeding.
description.zh_cn: 正常喂养并完成两次牛的繁殖，为聚落建立可持续的牧场。

description.en_us: Enchant one item with an enchanting table.
description.zh_cn: 使用附魔台为一件物品附魔，准备下一次探索。
